aliases.description: The aliases in the written file, sorted by name, with their delta to the file's previous entries.

added.description: Live entries the file did not have; all of them for a new alias.

removed.description: Entries the file had that are no longer live.

created.description: The file did not exist: bootstrapped from every editable alias.

generatedAt.description: When the document was made (RFC 3339, UTC).

prolexic.description: The prolexic version that made it.

written.description: False when the file already held exactly the exported bytes.
